versionStatusDefinitions.pinned: Exact value is present in this suite's manifest, template or build script; it is not an upstream support guarantee.
versionStatusDefinitions.minimum: Exact compatibility floor read from a manifest; not a recommended forever install target.
versionStatusDefinitions.live: Official rolling download/documentation page; no exact upstream version was independently pinned here.
versionStatusDefinitions.unverified: Official project location is identified, but release/version/build compatibility was not independently verified.

sources.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
sources.basis: Target package manifest and feature-inventory.json snapshot; does not prove all suite plugins or other distributions compatible.

sources.name: Node.js
sources.basis: Harness engine requirement. Select currently supported Node 24 LTS release; v24.9.0 release page confirms Windows x64 distribution, but it is not the suggested pin.

sources.name: pnpm
sources.basis: Official install guidance; package manager version is not pinned by the suite. Use only in generated plugin directories.

sources.name: Git for Windows
sources.basis: Official current download; this suite pins no Git release. Git Bash is an explicit executable path input.

sources.name: Python for Windows
sources.basis: Official rolling release page; Python version is not pinned by the bundled MCP server sources.

sources.name: Playwright MCP dependency
sources.basis: Exact ordinary dependency in feature inventory; browser/Chrome compatibility must be tested on target.

sources.name: Chrome DevTools MCP dependency
sources.basis: Exact ordinary dependency in feature inventory; custom page routing and Chrome compatibility must be tested on target.

sources.name: Google Chrome
sources.basis: Official rolling download page; suite has no verified Chrome minimum or fixed build.

sources.name: Blender
sources.basis: Official rolling download page; use an add-on and MCP server version that are mutually compatible, then verify in Blender.

sources.name: Blender MCP server
sources.basis: Upstream project location identified; this suite invokes blender_mcp.server but does not pin or validate an upstream release.

sources.name: Windows MCP server
sources.basis: Upstream source identified; this suite invokes python -m windows_mcp serve, but no tested package version is pinned.

sources.name: ComfyUI
sources.basis: Official rolling install documentation; installation mode depends on hardware and workflow. The SUPIR integration's port is not a universal ComfyUI default.

sources.name: ComfyUI Manager model list (SUPIR reference)
sources.basis: Model reference only; weights are not bundled. Confirm source, terms, hashes and workflow compatibility before download.

sources.name: Microsoft 365 / Office for Windows
sources.basis: Official installation guidance; product entitlement and version depend on the user's organization/account.

sources.name: WorkBuddy Windows client
sources.basis: Official Windows installation guide states Windows 10 or later; no fixed client version verified. User performs login.

sources.name: Drock image/video service
sources.basis: Service endpoint documented in suite skill; no API client install, account, quota, credential or paid generation verified.

sources.name: .NET SDK and runtimes
sources.basis: Official Windows installer guidance; optional desktop pin declares .NET 10 SDK/runtime requirement.

sources.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime
sources.basis: Suite requires the runtime only for optional native desktop pin; Evergreen is user-installed/serviced independently.

sources.name: Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet package used by build script
sources.basis: Exact version declared by optional whale desktop build script; only downloaded when explicitly opting into its restore operation.

sources.basis: Exact ordinary dependency in art-toolbox and session-categories; platform-specific native package must match target.

sources.basis: Exact ordinary dependency in dev-code-quality; other bundles may pin different versions.
